title: Gene Knockout Protocol
author: 宏亮 董
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7cqhivw

steps.title: Introduce pCas9 plasmid into ΔpfkA
steps.instruction: Transform the temperature‑sensitive, kanamycin‑resistant pCas9 plasmid into the recipient E. coli ΔpfkA strain.

steps.title: Grow culture with inducers
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the transformed bacterial suspension to 100 mL LB medium, incubate at 30 °C with shaking at 200 rpm for ~12 h; after 0.5 h add 2 % (w/v) of an unspecified additive to the LB and add arabinose to a final concentration of 0.5 % (w/v).

steps.title: Subculture to mid‑log phase
steps.instruction: Incubate the culture at 30 °C for 2–2.5 h until OD₆₀₀ reaches 0.55–0.60, then place the tube on ice for 30 min.

steps.title: Harvest and wash cells
steps.instruction: Collect the cells and perform three successive washes with pre‑cooled 10 % glycerol.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL pre‑cooled, sterilized 10 % glycerol on ice.
Repeat the centrifugation and resuspension two more times using 10 mL 10 % glycerol for the first two washes; for the final wash resuspend in 0.5 mL glycerol.

steps.title: Prepare electrocompetent aliquots
steps.instruction: Dispense 100 µL of the final cell suspension into each pre‑cooled centrifuge tube; use immediately for electroporation or store at –80 °C (stable for ~6 months).

steps.title: Amplify homology arms
steps.instruction: PCR‑amplify ~500 bp upstream and downstream sequences of the pykF gene, then fuse the two homology arms by overlap extension.

steps.title: Construct pTarget‑pykF vector
steps.instruction: Download the pykF gene sequence, identify a suitable gRNA target site, and replace bases 1961–1980 of the pTarget plasmid with the pykF fragment using restriction‑digestion/ligation or overlap‑extension; the resulting vector carries streptomycin resistance.

steps.title: Mix DNA with competent cells
steps.instruction: Add >200 ng of the assembled target fragment and >40 ng of the pTarget‑pykF plasmid to 100 µL of the competent cells on ice, incubate 10–30 min; keep the total volume of DNA (plasmid plus ligation product) ≤5 µL.

steps.title: Prepare electroporation cuvette
steps.instruction: UV‑sterilize a 2 mm electroporation cuvette for 20 min, keep it on ice, then quickly transfer the DNA‑cell mixture to the bottom of the cuvette; dry the outer wall of the cuvette before pulsing.

steps.title: Electroporate and recover cells
steps.instruction: Perform electroporation, immediately add 900–1000 µL of LB pre‑heated to 37 °C, mix gently, transfer the suspension to a 1.5 mL tube, and incubate at 30 °C, 150 rpm for 45–60 min.

steps.title: Plate on selective media
steps.instruction: Spread an appropriate volume of the recovered culture onto LB agar plates containing kanamycin and streptomycin.

steps.title: Verify knockout by colony PCR
steps.instruction: Design primers 700–1000 bp upstream and downstream of the genomic pykF locus; perform colony PCR on individual colonies to confirm deletion.

steps.title: Cure pTarget‑pykF plasmid
steps.instruction: Inoculate a verified knockout clone into LB with 1 mM IPTG, incubate at 30 °C for 12 h, then streak for single colonies; screen colonies for loss of streptomycin resistance (indicating pTarget elimination). Subsequently, eliminate the pCas9 plasmid by incubating at 37 °C.
